description: Motion logic for the first-person walkthrough video. Implemented by src/scene/walkthroughPath.ts (browser renderer) and described to NVIDIA Cosmos by Claude's video_prompt (see server/lib/prompts.ts).

engines.fallback: Browser renderer over the reconstructed 3D room (WebCodecs, 12 s @ 30 fps)

camera.height: photographer eye height from Claude's analysis (~1.4-1.7 m)
camera.stabilization: steady gimbal with a subtle walking head bob

keyframes.action: stand at the photo position, facing the room
pan right across the room while stepping in
walk (collision-free) to the stone close-up viewpoint and tilt down to the slab
slow pan across the stone grain

first_person_walkthrough.negative_prompt: people, hands, text, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality, flicker, warping walls, melting geometry, morphing furniture, changing stone pattern, fisheye distortion, fast motion, camera shake
